771: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ. ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ; ਸਬਦੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
O Lord, those who sing Your praises rest in spiritual poise; through His Word the Guru joins them to Your feet.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੇਰਾ; ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ. ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
Nanak: fruitful is the life of those whom the Guru sets on the Lord's path. ॥2॥
ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਲੁ ਭਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Those who come together with the company of the saints stay merged in the Lord's Name.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ. ਸਦ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤ ਭਏ; ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ. ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Through the Guru's Word, attuned to the Lord's Name, they remain free of Maya even while doing the world's work.
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ. ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ; ਮਨੂਆ ਰਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Those whom the Guru joined to the Lord's feet fixed their minds on the Lord's Name, and their minds were dyed in His love.
ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਪਾਇਆ. ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ॥
Keeping the Name in their hearts at all times, they removed attachment to Maya and attained the Lord, Giver of all comforts.
ਗੁਰਸਬਦੇ ਰਾਤਾ. ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤਾ; ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
The one dyed in the Guru's Word stays absorbed in spiritual poise and keeps the Lord's Name in the mind.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਨ ਘਰਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ; ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
Nanak: those who serve as the Guru teaches and stay merged in the Lord have joy in their hearts for ever. ॥3॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ. ਜਗੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ. ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Without the Guru the world wanders astray in doubt and cannot reach the Lord's presence.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ ਇਕਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ; ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
But some, the fortunate ones who turn to the Guru, the Guru has joined to the Lord's feet, and all their pains are removed.
ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਗਵਾਇਆ. ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ; ਸਦਾ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
When they become dear to the Lord's mind their pains are removed; dyed in His love, they ever sing His praises.
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਭਗਤ ਸਦਾ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ; ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਜਾਤੇ ॥
Such devotees of the Lord become pure for ever, and in every age they are known.
ਸਾਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ. ਦਰਿ ਜਾਪਹਿ; ਘਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
They worship the Eternal, are honoured at His door, and the eternal Lord comes to dwell in their hearts.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਚਾ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਚੀ ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ; ਸਬਦੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੪॥੫॥
Nanak: the Bani of praise dwells within them, lasting joy remains, and through the Word they have spiritual bliss. ॥4॥4॥5॥
ਜੇ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਵਰੁ. ਬਾਲੜੀਏ; ਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
O ignorant soul-bride, if you long to meet your Husband-Lord, keep your mind fixed on the Guru's feet.
ਸਦਾ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ; ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ. ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਏ, ਰਾਮ ॥
You will be wedded for ever, for the Lord, your Husband, never dies and never perishes.
ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ. ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਏ, ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ; ਸਾ ਧਨ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
The Lord neither dies nor perishes; the bride who, through the Guru, rests in poise and love is dear to her Husband.
ਸਚਿ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਮਲ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ ॥
Joined to the Eternal and restrained from vice, she becomes pure; through the Guru's Word she makes her spiritual life beautiful.
ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ. ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ; ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
O friend, my Lord is eternal, ever eternal; He Himself made Himself manifest.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਆਪਣਾ; ਜਿਨਿ. ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Nanak: the bride who fixed her mind on the Guru's feet ever enjoys union with her Husband. ॥1॥
ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਅੜਾ ਬਾਲੜੀਏ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
O ignorant soul-bride, the one who attains her Husband stays absorbed in spiritual poise at all times.
ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ; ਤਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਮੈਲੁ. ਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Through the Guru's teaching her mind is in bliss, and in that body there is not a trace of the filth of vice.
ਤਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਮੈਲੁ. ਨ ਰਾਤੀ, ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਤੀ; ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
There is not a trace of filth in her body; she stays dyed in the Lord's love, and my Lord joins her to His feet.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਣਾ; ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
Removing self-conceit from within, she remembers her Lord at all times.
ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ; ਅਪਣੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
Through the Guru's teaching she meets the Lord; the Guru settles her in poise, and she is dyed in her Beloved's love.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ॥੨॥
Nanak: she obtains the Name and honour; dyed in love, she remembers the Lord at all times. ॥2॥
ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੜੀਏ; ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
O bride dyed in the Lord's love, the one who remembers her Husband at all times,
ਸੋ ਸਹੋ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਦਾਤਾ; ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
and has removed self-conceit from within, has reached the presence of the Lord, utterly pure and Giver of all gifts.
ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ. ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
When it is the Lord's will, the bride removes attachment from within and becomes dear to His mind.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਚੇ; ਕਥੇ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
Then she ever sings the praises of the Eternal and speaks of the Lord whose form cannot be described.
ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਕੋ ਵਰਤੈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ. ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
O friend, through all four ages the One eternal Lord Himself runs His command, yet without the Guru no one has found Him.
772: ਨਾਨਕ. ਰੰਗਿ ਰਵੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ; ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Nanak: the bride who has fixed her mind on the Lord, dyed in His love, remembers Him with love. ॥3॥
ਕਾਮਣਿ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ; ਸਾਜਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
The bride who meets her dear Friend, the Lord, has bliss in her mind.
ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ; ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Following the Guru's teaching her mind becomes pure, and she keeps the Lord enshrined in her heart.
ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ. ਅਪਨਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਵਾਰੇ; ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Keeping the Lord enshrined in her heart, she fulfils her life's purpose; through the Guru's teaching she forms deep kinship with the Lord.
ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਲਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ; ਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
The Beloved has won over her mind, once caught in possessiveness, and she has attained union with the Creator.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮੰਨਿ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
Taking the Guru's refuge she has enjoyed lasting bliss, and the Lord, Destroyer of demons, has come to dwell in her mind.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਮੇਲਿ ਲਈ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੫॥੬॥
Nanak: through the Guru's Word she has made her life beautiful, and the dear Guru has joined her to the Lord's feet. ॥4॥5॥6॥
ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
The one who, through the Guru's Word, reflects on the Lord's Name has a wave of joy within.
ਹਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭੀਜੈ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Turning to the Guru, that person's mind and heart are soaked in the Lord's love, and that person loves the Lord's Name.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ. ਸਭਿ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Loving the Lord's Name, uttering with the mouth the Name and the Bani of His praise, that person saves all their family lines from vice.
ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣ ਰਹੇ. ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਘਰਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
Their comings and goings end; they enjoy unbroken bliss in the heart-home, and their attention stays merged in the Lord.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ, ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Nanak: the Lord shows mercy to that person, and that person attains union with Him.
ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
The one who, through the Guru's Word, reflects on the Lord's Name has a stream of spiritual joy within. ॥1॥
ਹਮ ਨੀਵੀ. ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਤਿ ਊਚਾ; ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
We souls are on a low spiritual level and God is far above it; how can we meet Him?
ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੀ. ਬਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ; ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
(Answer:) Whoever the Guru blesses, the Guru joins to the Lord; through the Guru's Word that bride merges in the Lord's love.
ਮਿਲੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ. ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ; ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣੇ ॥
Meeting the Lord through the Word and settled in His love, she removes self-conceit and, in love, enjoys union with Him.
ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥
When the Lord becomes dear to her, the bed of her heart fills with bliss, and she stays merged in the Lord's Name.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ; ਜੇ ਚਲੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਏ ॥
Nanak: the wedded bride becomes truly fortunate when she walks in the Guru's will.
ਹਮ ਨੀਵੀ. ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਤਿ ਊਚਾ; ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
Otherwise we souls are on a low spiritual level and God is far above it; we could not meet Him. ॥2॥
ਘਟਿ ਘਟੇ ਸਭਨਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਏਕੋ; ਏਕੋ ਰਾਮ ਭਤਾਰੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
In every body, in all beings, the one Lord, the Husband, dwells.
ਇਕਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਵਸੈ; ਇਕਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਆਧਾਰੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
Yet to some the Lord seems to dwell far away, while in the minds of others He alone is the support.
ਇਕਨਾ ਮਨ ਆਧਾਰੋ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ; ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
For some the Creator of all is the mind's support, for by great fortune they have found the Guru.
ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥
In every body dwells the one Lord and Master; the one who turns to the Guru has seen that unseen Lord.
ਸਹਜੇ ਅਨਦੁ ਹੋਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ; ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
Nanak: that person stays in spiritual poise, bliss remains within, and the mind is content reflecting on the Lord's virtues.
ਘਟਿ ਘਟੇ ਸਭਨਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਏਕੋ; ਏਕੋ ਰਾਮ ਭਤਾਰੋ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
In every body, in all beings, the one Lord, the Husband, dwells. ॥3॥
ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Those who take refuge in the Guru, Giver of the Lord's Name, stay merged in the Lord's Name.
ਹਰਿ ਧੂੜਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਮੈ, ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ; ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ. ਮੁਕਤੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
O Lord, grant me too the dust of the perfect Guru's feet; the Guru sets us sinners free from vice.
ਪਾਪੀ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਕਰਾਏ. ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ; ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
The Guru frees sinners from vice and removes their self-conceit; those who come to the Guru find their dwelling at the Lord's feet.
ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੁਧੀ ਸੁਖਿ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
Gaining from the Guru the wisdom to tell good deeds from bad, they pass the night of life in bliss; through the Guru's teaching and the Lord's Name, spiritual light dawns within.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਏ ॥
Nanak: the Lord's Name becomes sweet to them, and day and night there is spiritual bliss within them,
ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੪॥੬॥੭॥੫॥੭॥੧੨॥
those who take refuge in the Guru, Giver of the Name; they stay merged in the Lord's Name. ॥4॥6॥7॥5॥7॥12॥
773: Suhi · Chhant · Guru Ram Das · Ghar 1
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ; ਅਵਗਣ ਵਿਕਣਾ. ਗੁਣ ਰਵਾ. ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
O Lord, I am a sacrifice to You; unite me with the Guru, through whom I may dwell on Your virtues and trade away my faults.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ; ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਚਵਾ. ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
O Lord, remembering Your Name, may I ever utter the Guru's Bani.
ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਸਦ ਮੀਠੀ ਲਾਗੀ; ਪਾਪ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
The bride to whom the Guru's Bani is ever sweet removes sin and vice from within.
ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ; ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
Her disease of ego ends, every fear flees, and she stays ever in spiritual poise.
ਕਾਇਆ ਸੇਜ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ; ਗਿਆਨ ਤਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਭੋਗੋ ॥
Through the Guru's Word the bed of her heart becomes a home of comfort; joined to the Lord, the source of spiritual wisdom, she enjoys union with Him.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੁਖਿ ਮਾਣੇ ਨਿਤ ਰਲੀਆ; ਨਾਨਕ ਧੁਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੋ ॥੧॥
Nanak: the one whose union is written from the Lord's court stays in bliss at all times and ever enjoys union with Him. ॥1॥
ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਉ; ਕੁੜਮੁ ਕੁੜਮਾਈ ਆਇਆ. ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
O Lord, I am a sacrifice to You. The bride whom the Guru, the go-between, has come to meet to unite her with the Husband-Lord — creating in her the virtues of service, contentment and love,
ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਲੁ; ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਗਾਵਾਈਆ. ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
and joining her with the company of the saints, the Guru inspires her to sing the Bani of praise.
ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਗਾਈ. ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ; ਪੰਚ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੋਹਾਇਆ ॥
When she began singing the Bani of praise uttered by the Guru, she attained the highest spiritual state; her senses came together in praise of the Lord and became beautiful.
ਗਇਆ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਮਮਤਾ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਠੀ; ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Anger left her, the possessiveness in her body fled, and her hypocrisy and wandering were removed.
ਹਉਮੈ ਪੀਰ ਗਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਆਰੋਗਤ ਭਏ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
The pain of ego left her, her whole body became healthy, and she attained spiritual bliss.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ; ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥੨॥
Nanak: by the Guru's grace she formed kinship with the Lord, Master of virtues and profound. ॥2॥
ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਛੁੜੀ ਦੂਰਿ. ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ; ਬਲਿ ਗਈ. ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
The self-willed bride stays separated from the Husband-Lord, far from Him; she cannot reach His presence and keeps burning in craving.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਮਤਾ ਕੂਰਿ. ਕੂੜੁ ਵਿਹਾਝੇ; ਕੂੜਿ ਲਈ. ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
False possessiveness stays within her; she gathers only perishable Maya, and Maya keeps her in its grip.
ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ. ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ; ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਗੁ. ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
For Maya she practises falsehood and deceit and suffers great pain; without the Guru she does not find the right path of life.
ਉਝੜ ਪੰਥਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੈ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ; ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਧਕੇ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
The foolish bride wanders on a desolate path, where lust and the rest plunder her, and is pushed about at every moment.
ਆਪੇ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਤਾ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Those on whom the Lord, the Giver, Himself shows mercy, He brings to meet the all-powerful Guru.
ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਜਨ ਮੇਲੇ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥੩॥
Nanak: the Guru unites them, separated for many lives, with the Lord, settling them in poise and love. ॥3॥
ਆਇਆ ਲਗਨੁ ਗਣਾਇ; ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਨ ਓਮਾਹੀਆ. ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
As when the groom comes with the auspicious hour fixed, the bride is delighted in her heart,
ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪਾਧੇ ਆਣਿ; ਪਤੀ ਬਹਿ ਵਾਚਾਈਆ. ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
and the pandits and priests bring the horoscope and sit to read the time for the rounds,
ਪਤੀ ਵਾਚਾਈ. ਮਨਿ ਵਜੀ ਵਧਾਈ; ਜਬ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੁਣੇ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ॥
they read the horoscope, and when the bride hears that the friends have come to the house, a wave of joy rises in her mind.
ਗੁਣੀ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬਹਿ ਮਤਾ ਪਕਾਇਆ; ਫੇਰੇ ਤਤੁ ਦਿਵਾਏ ॥

The wise ones sit and settle the matter and at once have the rounds performed. (So too, by the Guru's grace the Lord becomes manifest within the soul-bride; those who relish the Bani read and reflect on it in the holy congregation, the Friend-Lord shines in her heart, and they unite her with her Husband.)
ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ; ਸਦ ਨਵਤਨੁ ਬਾਲ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
The bride finds her Husband, the Lord beyond reach and beyond the senses, ever fresh in love, her friend from childhood.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਮੇਲੇ; ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਕਦੇ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
Nanak: the bride whom the Lord unites with Himself in His mercy is never separated from Him again. ॥4॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿਲੜੀ ਲਾਵ; ਪਰਵਿਰਤੀ ਕਰਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ, ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
O Lord, I am a sacrifice to You. By Your grace the Guru has made the Sikh firm in the work of the Name; this is the first round of the soul-bride's wedding with the Husband-Lord.
ਬਾਣੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਵੇਦੁ, ਧਰਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਹੁ; ਪਾਪ ਤਜਾਇਆ, ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
The Guru's Bani is the Veda of Brahma for the Sikh; through it make the religion of the Name firm within you, and sins are removed.
ਧਰਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਹੁ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ; ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
Make this religion firm and meditate on the Lord's Name; the Guru's urging to remember the Name is itself the Simriti for the Sikh.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਰਾਧਹੁ; ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Keep the perfect Guru's teaching in mind at all times; by its grace all sins and vices are removed.
ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੋਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ; ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
The greatly fortunate one to whose mind the Lord's Name becomes sweet attains the bliss of spiritual poise.
774: ਜਨੁ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਲਾਵ ਪਹਿਲੀ; ਆਰੰਭੁ ਕਾਜੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Servant Nanak says: remembering the Lord's Name is the first round; with it the wedding with the Husband-Lord begins. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਦੂਜੜੀ ਲਾਵ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ. ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
O Lord, I am a sacrifice to You. This is the second round: in Your mercy You bring the soul-bride to meet the Guru, the great Being;
ਨਿਰਭਉ. ਭੈ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ. ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
her mind becomes fearless of the world's fears, and the Guru removes the filth of ego from within her.
ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਭਉ ਪਾਇਆ. ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਹਦੂਰੇ ॥
The bride who, rid of ego, sings the Lord's praises gains pure reverence for her Husband and sees the Lord ever present beside her.
ਹਰਿ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਸਰਬ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
She becomes sure that the world is the Lord spreading out His own self, and that the Master pervades all beings.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੋ; ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮੰਗਲ ਗਾਏ ॥
Within her and outside, only the one Lord appears; joining the Lord's servants, she sings songs of His praise.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਦੂਜੀ ਲਾਵ ਚਲਾਈ; ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਵਜਾਏ ॥੨॥
Servant Nanak: the Lord has set this second round in motion; within such a bride He sounds the unbroken music of the Bani of praise. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਤੀਜੜੀ ਲਾਵ; ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਭਇਆ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਆ. ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
O Lord, I am a sacrifice to You. In the minds of the detached ones a longing for union with You arises; this is the third round.
ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੁ; ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ. ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
Those greatly fortunate ones who find the company of the saints attain union with the Lord.
ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ. ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ; ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
They attain the pure Lord, sing His virtues, and with their mouths utter the Bani of His praise.
ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਕਥੀਐ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
The fortunate ones attain the Lord in the company of the saints; the praise of the indescribable Lord should ever be spoken.
ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੀ; ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
In the heart of one who praises Him the current of the Lord's love begins to flow; but the Lord's Name is repeated only when fortune awakens on the forehead.
ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੇ ਤੀਜੀ ਲਾਵੈ; ਹਰਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਮਨਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Servant Nanak says: in the third round a keen longing for the Lord is born in the bride's mind. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਚਉਥੜੀ ਲਾਵ. ਮਨਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਭਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ. ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
O Lord, I am a sacrifice to You. The bride in whose mind spiritual poise is born attains You; this is the fourth round.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਭਾਇ; ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਇਆ. ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
The bride who, turning to the Guru and settled in love, meets the Lord finds Him sweet to her mind and body.
ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਇਆ. ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਇਆ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
The one to whom the Lord is sweet becomes dear to my Lord, and keeps the mind fixed on Him at all times.
ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ ॥
That person obtains the Master, the fruit the heart longed for; through the Lord's Name, joy resounds within for ever.
ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਕਾਜੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ; ਧਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਿਗਾਸੀ ॥
The bride whose wedding the Lord, the Master, has arranged blossoms in her heart through the Name.
ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੇ ਚਉਥੀ ਲਾਵੈ; ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
Servant Nanak says: in the fourth round the bride attains the Lord, the imperishable God. ॥4॥2॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
Suhi · Chhant · Guru Ram Das · Ghar 2
The one who, turning to the Guru, sings the Lord's praises,
keeps them in the heart and relishes them with the tongue.
ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਏ. ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਏ; ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
The one who relishes the Lord with the tongue becomes dear to my God, and the Lord meets that person in poise and love.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੋਵੈ; ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
That person enjoys the bliss of praise at all times, rests in bliss, and through the Guru's Word keeps attention fixed on the Lord.
ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
But the perfect Guru is found by great fortune; the one who finds him meditates on the Name at all times.
ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੧॥
Nanak: that person stays in spiritual poise at all times, meets the Lord, the world's Life, and stays merged in the state no thought of Maya can touch. ॥1॥
The one who joins the company of the saints
bathes in the pure pool of the Lord's Name.
ਨਿਰਮਲਿ ਜਲਿ ਨਾਏ. ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਏ; ਭਏ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
Bathing in the pure water of the Name, that person's body becomes pure.
ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਈ. ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਾਗਾ; ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਨਠੀ ਪੀਰਾ ॥
The Name-water removes the filth of vice; the filth of evil thinking is washed away, wandering ends, and the pain of ego is destroyed.
ਨਦਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ; ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਆ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
But the holy congregation is found only by God's gracious glance; the one who finds it dwells at the Lord's feet.
775: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਏ; ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
Nanak: that person relishes with the tongue the songs of the Lord's praise, and the Name lights up spiritual life within. ॥2॥
The one who keeps the priceless jewel of the Lord's praise strung within,
and, turning to the Guru, loves the Lord's Name,
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ; ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
loving the Lord's Name is carried across by the Guru through the Word, who removes the darkness of spiritual ignorance from within.
ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡੁ ਬਲਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ; ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੋਹਾਇਆ ॥
A blazing light of spiritual wisdom shines in that heart, and all the senses take on a beautiful spiritual life.
ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਬਣਾਏ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Offering body and mind, that person creates the beauty of spiritual life and becomes dear to the eternal Lord.
ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਹੈ. ਸੋਈ ਪਰੁ ਕੀਜੈ; ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Nanak: that person stays merged in God's embrace, holding that whatever God commands is what should be done with care. ॥3॥
The bride whose wedding the Lord God has arranged,
He came through the Guru to wed (the bride He wishes to unite, He keeps in the Guru's refuge).
ਵੀਆਹਣਿ ਆਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ. ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਾ ਧਨ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
The bride on whom the Lord has mercy meets Him through the Guru and becomes dear to her Husband.
ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੰਗਲ ਗਾਏ; ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
Joining the saints she sings songs of the Husband-Lord's praise, and the Lord Himself makes her life beautiful.
ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਮਿਲਿ ਆਏ; ਅਪੂਰਬ ਜੰਞ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
As wedding guests gather, saints of godly virtue and devotees who sing His praise come together and form a wondrous wedding party.
ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਸਾਚਾ; ਨਾ ਕਦੇ ਮਰੈ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
Nanak: through that congregation she meets the dear Lord, who is eternal and never dies or is born. ॥4॥1॥3॥
Suhi · Chhant · Guru Ram Das · Ghar 3
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਆਵਹੋ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ; ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Come, O saints, let us join together and sing the Lord's praises.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਐ; ਘਰਿ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਸਬਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Taking the Guru's refuge we should stay joined to the Lord; then the many words of His praise hold sway in the heart-home.
ਸਬਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ; ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ॥
O Lord, as the words of Your praise take effect in the heart, You are seen dwelling everywhere.
ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਜਪੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ; ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
O Lord, have mercy on me too, that day and night I may repeat Your Name, ever praise You, and keep my attention on Your eternal praise.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਹੈ. ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
The one who makes the Lord's Name the worship of the heart stays in spiritual poise at all times, dyed in His love.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥
Nanak: through the Guru that person forms kinship with the One alone, and with no other. ॥1॥
ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
That Lord knows every heart and pervades all beings.
ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਵੈ, ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
But only the one who remembers Him through the Guru's Word sees that Master pervading everywhere.
ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸੋਈ ॥
Only that person becomes sure that the Master-Lord knows every heart and is present in every body.
ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ. ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ; ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Following the Guru's teaching the eternal Lord is found, one stays merged in poise, and becomes sure there is no one but Him.
ਸਹਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਜੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਾ; ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
If, by His own grace, I become pleasing to Him, then resting in poise I can sing His praises; He Himself unites beings with Himself.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਜਾਪੈ; ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੨॥
Nanak: only through the Guru's Word can one form deep kinship with that Lord; the one joined to the Word meditates on the Name day and night. ॥2॥
ਇਹੁ ਜਗੋ ਦੁਤਰੁ; ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਪਾਰਿ. ਨ ਪਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
This world is an ocean hard to cross; the self-willed cannot reach the far shore,
ਅੰਤਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ; ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
for within them stay ego, possessiveness, lust, anger and cleverness.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ. ਥਾਇ, ਨ ਪਾਈ; ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
The one within whom pride in cleverness stays is not accepted at the Lord's door and wastes this human life.
ਜਮ ਮਗਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਵੈ; ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਇਆ ॥
All life long that person walks Death's road, suffers pain, takes the blows of spiritual death, and leaves at the end wringing hands.
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਕੋ ਬੇਲੀ ਨਾਹੀ; ਪੁਤੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਸੁਤੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
Son, family, brother: none of these is a helper on life's journey; without the Lord's Name no one becomes a friend.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ; ਆਗੈ ਸਾਥਿ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
Nanak: all this is the spread of attachment to Maya, which does not go along into the world beyond. ॥3॥
ਹਉ ਪੂਛਉ ਅਪਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ; ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ. ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
When I ask my Guru, Giver of the Name, how this hard-to-cross world-ocean can be crossed,
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ਚਲਹੁ; ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਇਵ ਮਰੀਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
the answer comes: walk in the Guru's will; thus, while doing the world's work, one stays dead to vice.
ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਮਰੀਐ. ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰੀਐ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
Dying to vice while still alive, one crosses the world-ocean, for the one who turns to the Guru stays merged in the Name.
776: ਪੂਰਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ; ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
By great fortune that person meets the Lord, full of all virtues, and keeps attention fixed on the eternal Name.
ਮਤਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਭਈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
The light of spiritual understanding dawns in the intellect, the mind is content in the Name, and through the Name honour is received.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥
Nanak: the one joined to the Guru's Word meets God, and that soul stays one with God's Light. ॥4॥1॥4॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਗੁਰੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨੋ. ਪਿਆਰਾ ਮੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ; ਮੇਰੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝਿ ਗਈਆਸੇ ॥
O saints, I have met the dear Guru, and by his grace my craving for Maya is quenched.
ਹਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੈ; ਮੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੇ ॥
The Guru unites me with God, the treasure of virtues; I offer my mind and body to the Guru.
ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ; ਮੈ ਦਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਬਾਸੇ ॥
Blessed is the Guru, the great Being; bravo to the Guru, who tells me of the Lord.
ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਿਗਾਸੇ ॥੧॥
Servant Nanak: those who find the Lord by great fortune blossom with bliss, joined to the Name. ॥1॥
ਗੁਰੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ. ਮੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪੰਥੁ ਦਸਾਹਾ ॥
O saints, since I met the dear Guru, my friend, I keep asking him the way to the Lord,
ਘਰਿ ਆਵਹੁ ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ; ਮਿਲੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਹਾ ॥
and I keep saying to the Lord: O Husband-Lord, through the Guru's Word come and meet me, long separated; come and dwell in my heart-home.
ਹਉ ਤੁਝੁ ਬਾਝਹੁ. ਖਰੀ ਉਡੀਣੀਆ; ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੀਨੁ ਮਰਾਹਾ ॥
O Lord, as a fish dies without water, so without You I am deeply forlorn.
ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ॥੨॥
Servant Nanak: those who by great fortune meditated on the Lord merged in His Name. ॥2॥
ਮਨੁ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਚਲਿ ਚਲਿ ਭਰਮਿਆ; ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
The self-willed person, gone astray in the wandering of Maya, has a mind that runs and runs in all ten directions.
ਨਿਤ ਆਸਾ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਵੈ; ਮਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਲਗਾਇਆ ॥
In the mind that person ever dwells on hopes of Maya, and craving and hunger for Maya cling to the mind.
ਅਨਤਾ ਧਨੁ. ਧਰਿ ਦਬਿਆ; ਫਿਰਿ. ਬਿਖੁ ਭਾਲਣ ਗਇਆ ॥
That person buries endless wealth in the ground, yet still goes searching for more of the poison of Maya that brings spiritual death.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਪਚਿ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਇਆ ॥੩॥
Servant Nanak: keep repeating the Lord's Name; cut off from the Name, people burn in craving and bring on spiritual death. ॥3॥
ਗੁਰੁ ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਮੋਹਨੁ ਪਾਇ ਕਰੇ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਾਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
Meeting the dear, beautiful Guru, my mind has been pierced by the arrows of love,
ਮੇਰੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸੁਧਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਗਈ; ਮਨ ਆਸਾ ਚਿੰਤ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
the anxious, scheming awareness has gone from my heart, and I have let go of my mind's hopes and worries.
ਮੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵੇਦਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੀ; ਗੁਰ ਦੇਖਤ. ਮਨੁ ਸਾਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
Now the ache of love stays within me; seeing the Guru, my mind has found patience.
ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੁ; ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੫॥
Servant Nanak, pray thus: O God, by my good fortune come and meet me; I am a sacrifice to You at every moment. ॥4॥1॥5॥
ਮਾਰੇਹਿਸੁ. ਵੇ ਜਨ, ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖਿਆ; ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਣ. ਨ ਦਿਤੀਆ ॥
Kill the ego and the Maya that never let the soul meet the Lord.
ਦੇਹ ਕੰਚਨ ਵੇ ਵੰਨੀਆ; ਇਨਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਵਿਗੁਤੀਆ ॥
Look: this body is beautiful like the colour of gold, but where ego enters, ego ruins it.
ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਵੇ. ਸਭ ਕਾਲਖਾ; ਇਨਿ. ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੂੜਿ ਸਜੁਤੀਆ ॥
Attachment to Maya is sheer blackness, yet this foolish self-willed person has bound himself to it.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਬਰੇ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਛੁਟੀਆ ॥੧॥
Servant Nanak: those who turn to the Guru are saved; through the Guru's Word they are freed from ego. ॥1॥
ਵਸਿ ਆਣਿਹੁ. ਵੇ ਜਨ, ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ; ਮਨੁ ਬਾਸੇ ਜਿਉ. ਨਿਤ ਭਉਦਿਆ ॥
Keep this mind under control, for the mind ever wanders like a hawk.
ਦੁਖਿ ਰੈਣਿ ਵੇ. ਵਿਹਾਣੀਆ; ਨਿਤ ਆਸਾ ਆਸ ਕਰੇਦਿਆ ॥
Ever building hope upon hope, a person's whole night of life passes in pain.
ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ. ਵੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨੋ; ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ਪੂਰੀ. ਹਰਿ ਚਉਦਿਆ ॥
O saints, the one who finds the Guru begins to repeat the Lord's Name, and in repeating it the mind's longing for the Name is fulfilled.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਤੀ; ਛਡਿ ਆਸਾ. ਨਿਤ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਉਦਿਆ ॥੨॥
Servant Nanak, pray: O God, give me the understanding to repeat Your Name; the one who repeats it drops worldly hopes and rests in bliss. ॥2॥
ਸਾ ਧਨ. ਆਸਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰੇ, ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੇਜੜੀਐ ਆਈ ॥
The bride who stays in the Guru's refuge ever longs in her heart for union and says: O Sovereign Lord, come to the beautiful bed of my heart.
ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਅਗਮ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ. ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜਿਆ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
O Sovereign Lord, You are my Master and the source of mercy, but You are beyond my reach; in Your grace unite me with Yourself.
777: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਲੋਚਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ. ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਸੇਜ ਵਿਛਾਈ ॥
O Sovereign Lord, through the Guru a longing for You has arisen in my mind and body; I have spread the bed of faith.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣੀਆ. ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜਿਆ; ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥੩॥
Servant Nanak: O Sovereign Lord, the bride who is dear to You, You meet as she rests in poise and love. ॥3॥
ਇਕਤੁ ਸੇਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੋ. ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜਿਆ; ਗੁਰੁ ਦਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇਈ ॥
The Lord dwells on the one bed of the bride's heart; the bride to whom the Guru shows the way, the Guru unites with the Lord.
ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਹੈ. ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜਿਆ; ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇਈ ॥
In my mind and heart there is a pull and a longing for the Lord, but the Guru unites with Him only the one on whom he shows mercy.
ਹਉ. ਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਇਆ. ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜਿਆ; ਜੀਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਦੇਈ ॥
I am a sacrifice to the Guru; I offer my life to the Guru.
ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਜੀਉ. ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜਿਆ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੬॥੫॥੭॥੬॥੧੮॥
Servant Nanak: the one on whom the Guru is pleased, he unites with the Lord. ॥4॥2॥6॥5॥7॥6॥18॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਸੁਣਿ ਬਾਵਰੇ; ਤੂ ਕਾਏ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੁਲਾਨਾ ॥
O person crazed by Maya, listen closely: why do you stray from life's path at the sight of Maya?
ਸੁਣਿ ਬਾਵਰੇ; ਨੇਹੁ ਕੂੜਾ ਲਾਇਓ, ਕੁਸੰਭ ਰੰਗਾਨਾ ॥
Listen, crazed one: Maya is like the colour of safflower, and you have formed a love for it that will not last.
ਕੂੜੀ ਡੇਖਿ ਭੁਲੋ, ਅਢੁ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਮੁਲੋ; ਗੋਵਿਦ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਜੀਠਾ ॥
You stray at the sight of the perishable, which in the end is not worth half a shell; the Lord's Name alone, like fast madder dye, stays with you for ever.
ਥੀਵਹਿ ਲਾਲਾ ਅਤਿ ਗੁਲਾਲਾ; ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
If, forming deep kinship with the Guru's sweet Word, you repeat the Lord's Name, you will become a deep-red, beautiful flower.
ਮਿਥਿਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਗਨੁ ਥੀ ਰਹਿਆ; ਝੂਠ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਪਟਾਨਾ ॥
But you are absorbed in attachment to the perishable and cling to things that will not stay with you.
ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਨ ਸਰਣਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ; ਰਾਖੁ ਲਾਜ ਭਗਤਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
Nanak, say: O treasure of mercy, I, the lowly, have come to Your refuge; keep my honour, as You keep the honour of Your devotees. ॥1॥
ਸੁਣਿ ਬਾਵਰੇ; ਸੇਵਿ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨਾਥੁ ਪਰਾਣਾ ॥
Listen, crazed one: serve and worship the Lord, Master of life.
ਸੁਣਿ ਬਾਵਰੇ; ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
Listen, crazed one: no one stays here for ever; whoever has come must also go.
ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹਭ ਵੈਸੀ. ਸੁਣਿ ਪਰਦੇਸੀ; ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
Listen, O stranger in a foreign land: the world you think permanent will all pass away; stay joined to the Lord in the company of the saints.
ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਾਗੀ. ਸੁਣਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ; ਚਰਣ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਗਹਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
Listen: only by turning away from attachment to Maya, and by good fortune, is the Lord found; so hold fast to God's feet.
ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ. ਸੰਕ, ਨ ਕੀਜੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ. ਤਜਿ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣਾ ॥
Hand this mind over to the Guru without the slightest hesitation; in the Guru's refuge, cast out your pride.
ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਨ ਭਗਤ ਭਵ ਤਾਰਣ; ਤੇਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਾ ॥੨॥
Nanak, pray: O Carrier of the lowly and the devotees across the world-ocean, which of Your countless virtues can I describe? ॥2॥
ਸੁਣਿ ਬਾਵਰੇ; ਕਿਆ ਕੀਚੈ ਕੂੜਾ ਮਾਨੋ ॥
O crazed one, why take false pride in perishable things?
ਸੁਣਿ ਬਾਵਰੇ; ਹਭੁ ਵੈਸੀ ਗਰਬੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੋ ॥
Listen, crazed one: when the ties to things break, all this pride and arrogance will go too.
ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹਭ ਜਾਣਾ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਮਾਣਾ; ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹੋਇ ਦਾਸਾ ॥
The world you think permanent will all pass away; pride in it is false. Stay here as a servant of the Guru and of God.
ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੀਐ. ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰੀਐ; ਜੇ ਥੀਵੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖਿਆਸਾ ॥
If one keeps self-conceit removed, dead while alive, one crosses the world-ocean, but only if it is so written by the Lord's grace.
ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀਜੈ. ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ; ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੋ ॥
Stay in the Guru's refuge; from him alone can the life-giving water of the Name be drunk. O Lord, only the one whose attention You settle in poise drinks it.
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੈ; ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੋ ॥੩॥
O Lord, Nanak has come to Your door and taken Your refuge; I am for ever a sacrifice to You. ॥3॥
ਸੁਣਿ ਬਾਵਰੇ; ਮਤੁ ਜਾਣਹਿ. ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
O person crazed by Maya, listen: do not think that, while proud of Maya, you have attained God.
ਸੁਣਿ ਬਾਵਰੇ; ਥੀਉ ਰੇਣੁ. ਜਿਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Listen, crazed one: become the dust of the feet of those who have meditated on God; only so is God met.
ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ. ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Whoever has meditated on God has attained spiritual bliss; by great fortune the sight of the Lord is gained.
ਥੀਉ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ; ਸਗਲਾ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਟਾਈਐ ॥
Be humble, ever a sacrifice to those who have meditated on God; self-conceit must be wholly removed.
ਓਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਭਾਗ ਸੁਧਾ, ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਧਾ; ਹਮ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ. ਆਪੁ ਵੇਚਾਇਆ ॥
The one who has attained union with God is praiseworthy and fortunate; I have given myself over to such a person.
ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਨ. ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ; ਰਾਖੁ ਲਾਜ ਅਪਨਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
Nanak, say: O Helper of the lowly, Ocean of comfort, I have come to Your refuge; keep the honour of Your own servant. ॥4॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਤੀ ਤੁਸਿ ਕੈ; ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
I am a sacrifice to the beautiful Lord; by His grace the Guru, in kindness, has given me the support of His lotus feet.
778: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ; ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ. ਘਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ, ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
I am a sacrifice to that Lord; in His house everything is present, and His storehouses are full of the life-giving water of the Name.
ਬਾਬੁਲੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਵਡ ਸਮਰਥਾ; ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਾਰਾ ॥
My Father-Lord is all-powerful; He can bring about every cause.
ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ. ਦੁਖੁ ਕੋਈ, ਨ ਲਾਗੈ; ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ॥
He is such that, remembering His Name, no pain can touch one, and His Name carries one across the world-ocean.
ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ; ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੀਵਾ ॥
From the beginning of creation He has been the protector of His devotees; praising Him again and again, I gain spiritual life.
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪੀਵਾ ॥੧॥
Nanak, say: His Name is sweet, the greatest of all relishes; at all times I drink it through my mind and senses. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ; ਕਿਉ ਵੇਛੋੜਾ ਥੀਵਈ. ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
I am a sacrifice to the beautiful Lord; whoever He Himself joins to His feet is never separated from Him again. O Lord, I am a sacrifice to You.
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ; ਸੋ ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਜੀਵਈ. ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
The one who gains Your support keeps spiritual life for ever.
ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਤੁਝੈ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ; ਸਾਚੇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
But, O eternal Creator of all, Your support is received from You alone.
ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਖਾਲੀ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ; ਐਸਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
You are such a Master of ours that no one ever goes empty-handed from Your door.
ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ; ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਆਸ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥
O Lord, Your saints join together and sing songs of Your praise; day and night their hope is in You alone.
ਸਫਲੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Nanak, say: O Lord, I am ever a sacrifice to You; by Your grace one meets the perfect Guru, whose sight fulfils every wish. ॥2॥
ਸੰਮੑਲਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਥਾਨੁ; ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ, ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
I am a sacrifice to the Lord. The one who took hold of the eternal Lord's door met the eternal Lord and received honour and glory from His door,
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਦਇਆਲੁ; ਗੁਣ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਗਾਇਆ. ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
the one who, by the Lord's grace, met the Guru, the source of mercy, began singing the praises of the imperishable Lord.
ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ, ਗਾਉ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ; ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਆਮੀਆ ॥
Ever sing the praises of the beloved Lord, the Master of life.
ਸੁਭ ਦਿਵਸ ਆਏ. ਗਹਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਏ; ਮਿਲੇ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀਆ ॥
For the one who sings His praises, the good days of life keep coming; the Lord holds that person to His heart, and the Knower of hearts meets that person.
ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਵਜਹਿ ਵਾਜੇ; ਅਨਹਦਾ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੇ ॥
Within that person, high conduct and contentment hold full sway, as if their instruments were playing; their sweet, unbroken melody resounds within.
ਸੁਣਿ ਭੈ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਸਗਲ ਨਾਨਕ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Nanak: hearing the praises of God, the Being who can do all, all one's fears are destroyed. ॥3॥
ਉਪਜਿਆ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ; ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਪੇਈਐ ਇਕੁ ਹਰਿ, ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
I am a sacrifice to the Lord. Within the one who ever remembers Him, true spiritual understanding arises, and that person sees the one Lord in this world and the next.
ਬ੍ਰਹਮੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ; ਕੋਇ. ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਭਿੰਨ ਕਰਿ, ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
That soul so meets the Lord that no one can separate them.
ਬਿਸਮੁ ਪੇਖੈ ਬਿਸਮੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ; ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
That person sees the wondrous Lord everywhere, hears Him speaking everywhere, and sees Him alone everywhere.
ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
In water, on land and in the sky that person sees the Master pervading; He is present in every heart.
ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਆ. ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ; ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ. ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
That person stays merged in the Lord from whom he came; the worth of that exalted spiritual state cannot be told,
ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਚਲਤ. ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਲਖਣੇ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੪॥੨॥
for he ever meditates on Him whose wondrous plays cannot be described. Nanak: meditate on Him. ॥4॥2॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
Those people begin to sing the Lord's praises,
and, steeped in the Lord's love, stay awake at all times against Maya's attacks,
ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਜਾਗੇ. ਪਾਪ ਭਾਗੇ; ਮਿਲੇ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥
who meet the dear Guru; as they wake in the Lord's love, all their sins flee.
ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਲਾਗੇ. ਭਰਮ ਭਾਗੇ; ਕਾਜ ਸਗਲ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
Those who fall at the Guru's feet are rid of all wandering, and all their affairs are set right.
ਸੁਣਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਣ ਬਾਣੀ. ਸਹਜਿ ਜਾਣੀ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੈ ॥
The one who by great fortune hears the Guru's Bani with the ears and repeats the Lord's Name forms deep kinship with the Lord in poise.
ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਗੈ ॥੧॥
Nanak prays: that person takes refuge in the Master and places life and body, everything, before God. ॥1॥
Those who sang the eternal Lord's song of praise at all times,
find the Bani of praise ever unbroken and sweet to the ears.
ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ. ਦੂਖ ਨਾਸੇ; ਰਹਸੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਮਨਿ ਘਣਾ ॥
Singing the Lord's praises, all their pains are destroyed and great joy wells up in their minds.
ਮਨੁ ਤੰਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ; ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਣਾ ॥
Seeing those who utter God's Name with their mouths, mind and body become pure.
779: ਹੋਇ ਰੇਣ ਸਾਧੂ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਰਾਧੂ; ਆਪਣੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਾ ॥
Those who, becoming the dust of the Guru's feet, worship God become dear to their Lord.
ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਹੁ; ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ॥੨॥
Nanak prays: O God, have mercy, that I may ever sing Your praises. ॥2॥
Meeting the Guru, the world-ocean can be crossed;
repeating the Lord's Name, one is carried across.
ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਧਿਆਏ. ਸਭਿ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ; ਮਿਟੇ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
The one who keeps attention on the Lord's feet obtains every wished-for fruit, and the round of birth and death ends.
ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ. ਸੁਭਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ; ਆਪਣੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਾ ॥
Repeating the Lord's Name with love and a devotional nature, that person becomes dear to his Lord.
ਜਪਿ ਏਕੁ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ਪੂਰਨ; ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ. ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
Repeat the Name of the one Lord, unseen, infinite and all-pervading; there is no other but Him.
ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਿ, ਭਰਮੁ ਖੋਇਆ; ਜਤ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਤ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
Nanak prays: the Guru has removed my wandering; wherever I look, I see Him alone. ॥3॥
and brings all the works of the saints to completion.
ਗੁਰੁ ਸੰਤੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ; ਸਗਲ ਇਛਾ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ ॥
Those who found the saintly Guru began to remember God, and all their wishes came to be fulfilled.
ਹਉ ਤਾਪ ਬਿਨਸੇ. ਸਦਾ ਸਰਸੇ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲੇ ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ॥
The torment of ego was destroyed within them, they stayed ever cheerful, and, long separated, they met God.
ਮਨਿ ਸਾਤਿ ਆਈ. ਵਜੀ ਵਧਾਈ; ਮਨਹੁ ਕਦੇ. ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ॥
Coolness came into their minds, rising spirits took hold within, and the Lord's Name is never forgotten by them.
ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ; ਸਦਾ ਭਜੁ ਜਗਦੀਸਰੈ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
Nanak prays: the Guru has made this firm in the heart, ever to repeat the Name of the world's Master. ॥4॥1॥3॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਤੂ ਠਾਕੁਰੋ ਬੈਰਾਗਰੋ; ਮੈ ਜੇਹੀ ਘਣ ਚੇਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
O Lord, You are the Master of all, and Maya has no hold on You; there are countless servant-girls like me at Your door.
ਤੂੰ ਸਾਗਰੋ ਰਤਨਾਗਰੋ; ਹਉ ਸਾਰ. ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
O Lord, You are the ocean, the mine of jewels; I have not understood Your worth.
ਸਾਰ. ਨ ਜਾਣਾ, ਤੂ ਵਡ ਦਾਣਾ; ਕਰਿ ਮਿਹਰੰਮਤਿ ਸਾਂਈ ॥
O my Master, I do not know the worth of Your virtues; You are all-wise; have mercy on me.
ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ. ਸਾ ਮਤਿ ਦੀਜੈ; ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
Be gracious and give me such understanding that I may meditate on You at all hours.
ਗਰਬੁ. ਨ ਕੀਜੈ, ਰੇਣ ਹੋਵੀਜੈ; ਤਾ ਗਤਿ ਜੀਅਰੇ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
O soul, do not be proud; be the dust of everyone's feet, and only then will you attain a high spiritual state.
ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਮੈ ਜੇਹੀ ਘਣ ਚੇਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
Nanak, say: my Master is above all; there are countless servant-girls like me at His door. ॥1॥
ਤੁਮੑ ਗਉਹਰ ਅਤਿ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ; ਤੁਮ ਪਿਰ. ਹਮ ਬਹੁਰੀਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
O God, You are a priceless pearl, an unfathomable ocean, profound of heart; You are our Husband and we are Your brides.
ਤੁਮ ਵਡੇ ਵਡੇ. ਵਡ ਊਚੇ; ਹਉ ਇਤਨੀਕ ਲਹੁਰੀਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
You are infinitely great, infinitely high; I am a tiny being.
ਹਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ. ਏਕੋ ਤੂਹੈ; ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਜਾਨਾ ॥
I am nothing; You alone are; You Yourself know all.
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨਿਮਖ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਵਾ; ਸਰਬ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਮਾਨਾ ॥
O God, through Your life-giving glance, for even the blink of an eye, I receive spiritual life, as if I had enjoyed every pleasure.
ਚਰਣਹ ਸਰਨੀ ਦਾਸਹ ਦਾਸੀ; ਮਨਿ ਮਉਲੈ. ਤਨੁ ਹਰੀਆ ॥
I have taken refuge at Your feet and am the servant of Your servants; when my mind blossoms, my body too becomes green.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਣਾ; ਆਪਨ ਭਾਵਨ ਕਰੀਆ ॥੨॥
Nanak, say: the Master pervades all beings and ever does as He wills. ॥2॥
ਤੁਝੁ ਊਪਰਿ. ਮੇਰਾ ਹੈ ਮਾਣਾ; ਤੂਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਤਾਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
O Lord, my pride is in You alone; You alone are my strength.
ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਤੇਰੀ; ਤੂ ਜਾਣਾਇਹਿ ਜਾਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Whatever awareness, intellect and cleverness I have are Yours; whatever You make me understand, that I understand.
ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ਪਛਾਣੈ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਸਿਰੰਦੇ ॥
Only the one on whom the Creator casts His gracious glance understands and recognises the right way of life.
ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭੂਲੀ. ਬਹੁਤੀ ਰਾਹੀ; ਫਾਥੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਫੰਦੇ ॥
The self-willed bride strays onto many other paths and stays caught in the snares of Maya.
ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਾਣੀ. ਸਾ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ; ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸਭ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਾ ॥
The bride who pleases the Master becomes virtuous; she alone has enjoyed all spiritual bliss.
ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਧਰ. ਤੂਹੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ; ਤੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਮਾਣਾ ॥੩॥
O Master, You alone are Nanak's support; You are Nanak's pride. ॥3॥
ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਵੰਞਾ ਘੋਲੀ ਵੰਞਾ ਤੂ; ਪਰਬਤੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਓਲੑਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
O God, You are a mountain of shelter for me; I am a sacrifice to You.
ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ. ਲਖ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਬਰੀਆ; ਜਿਨਿ. ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਪਰਦਾ ਖੋਲੑਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
I am a sacrifice to You hundreds of thousands of times, for You have removed the gap of wandering from within me.
780: ਮਿਟੇ ਅੰਧਾਰੇ. ਤਜੇ ਬਿਕਾਰੇ; ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾ ॥
The bride whose mind is absorbed in the Master gives up all vices, and the darkness of attachment to Maya is dispelled within her.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਭਾਣੀ ਭਈ ਨਿਕਾਣੀ; ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ॥
The bride who becomes pleasing to God becomes dependent on no one; her life becomes fruitful and she is accepted at God's door.
ਭਈ ਅਮੋਲੀ. ਭਾਰਾ ਤੋਲੀ; ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਦਰੁ ਖੋਲੑਾ ॥
Her life becomes priceless and weighty; the door opens for her where she is freed from vice and learns the true way of living.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਉ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹੋਈ; ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਓਲੑਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥
Nanak, say: since that God became my shelter, I have become fearless of the attacks of vice and Maya. ॥4॥1॥4॥
ਸਾਜਨੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪੂਰਾ; ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
The Guru, the great Being, is my true friend; apart from him I know no other who can give me understanding of the Lord.
ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ; ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
The Guru is as dear to my mind as mother, father, brother, son, relatives, soul and breath.
ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਦੀਆ; ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣਾ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
The Guru has given the understanding that life and body are all given by the Lord, who is full of all virtues.
ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ; ਸਰਬ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
My Lord, the Knower of every heart, pervades everywhere.
ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ. ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ; ਹੋਏ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣਾ ॥
In His refuge every comfort and joy is received.
ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
Nanak, say: by the Guru's grace I am for ever and ever a sacrifice to God. ॥1॥
ਐਸਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ; ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Such a Guru is found by great fortune, meeting whom understanding of God dawns in the heart,
ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਉਤਰਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਧੂੜੀ ਨਿਤ ਨਾਪੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
the sins of many lives are removed, and one ever bathes in the dust of the feet of the Lord's saints.
ਹਰਿ ਧੂੜੀ ਨਾਈਐ. ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜੋਨਿ. ਨ ਆਈਐ ॥
Through him one bathes in the dust of the saints' feet and remembers God, and does not enter the round of births again.
ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੇ; ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Falling at the Guru's feet, doubt and fear flee and every fruit the mind longs for is obtained.
ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਏ. ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ; ਫਿਰਿ. ਸੋਗੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥
The one who, in the Guru's refuge, has ever sung the Lord's praises and meditated on the Name is never again touched by grief or torment.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ; ਪੂਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਰਤਾਪੈ ॥੨॥
Nanak: by the Guru's grace one understands that God, whose glory is perfect, alone is the Giver of life. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧੇ; ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਆਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
The Lord, treasure of all virtues, stays under the sway of His saints' love.
ਸੰਤ ਚਰਣ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੇ; ਤਿਨੀ ਪਰਮ ਪਦ ਪਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Those who fall at the saints' feet and devote themselves to serving the Guru attain the highest spiritual state.
ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ. ਆਪੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
The one on whom the perfect Lord showed mercy removed self-conceit and attained the highest spiritual state.
ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ; ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
That person's life became fruitful, every fear fled, and that person met the Lord, who alone is.
ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ. ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੀਆ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
The Lord who created that person joined him to His feet, and that soul became one with the Lord's Light.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਜਪੀਐ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Nanak: ever repeat the Name of the immaculate Lord; whoever repeated it after meeting the Guru attained spiritual bliss. ॥3॥
ਗਾਉ ਮੰਗਲੋ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਜਨਹੁ; ਪੁੰਨੀ ਇਛ ਸਬਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
O saints, ever sing the song of the Lord's praise; through it every wish is fulfilled.
ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੇਤੀ; ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ, ਰਾਮ ॥
Through praise people stay dyed in the love of the Master who never dies and never comes or goes in birth and death.
ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ; ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪਾਏ ॥
Whoever meditated on the Name attained the imperishable Lord and obtained every wish.
ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ; ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
Fixing the mind on the Guru's feet, one gains peace and enjoys the many joys of spiritual poise.
ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ; ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਈ ॥
Through remembrance one becomes sure that the imperishable Lord pervades every place and every body.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲੇ ਪੂਰੇ; ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੫॥
Nanak says: fixing the mind on the Guru's feet, all affairs are accomplished. ॥4॥2॥5॥
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
O my beloved Master, have mercy, that my eyes may ever behold Your sight.
ਲਾਖ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਦੇਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਮੁਖੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
O my beloved, give me a hundred thousand tongues to repeat Your Name; be merciful, that my mouth may ever repeat Your Name.
ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧੇ. ਜਮ ਪੰਥੁ ਸਾਧੇ; ਦੂਖੁ. ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
May my mouth repeat Your Name, by which Death's road is conquered and no pain can take hold of me.
ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਜਤ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਤ ਸੋਈ ॥
O Master, pervading water, land and sky, have mercy, that wherever I look I may see Your form alone.
ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਨਾਠੇ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੇਰ ਹੂ ਤੇ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
By repeating the Lord's Name all doubt, attachment and vice flee, and God is seen as nearest of the near.
